item.title: DEC expects avian flu to increase during winter
item.description: According to the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation, Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza continues to infect birds and mammals across the U.S. and Canada, including New York State. In November and December 2025, DEC received 69 reports of suspect mortalities, and presumptive positive cases were detected in wild birds in 10 counties. HPAI incidence may remain high through spring when large numbers of ducks and geese will migrate through the state. There is no treatment for HPAI
